dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies (USGS and Department of Commerce) and researchers receiving external grants through the monitoring system.
dimensions.evidence: National Volcano Early Warning and Monitoring System of the U.S. Geological Survey

dimensions.assessment: Continues an existing monitoring program and authorizes specific funding caps for operations.
dimensions.evidence: The system, implemented by the USGS in collaboration with the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, includes a monitoring network

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $470,000 annually for the Secretary of Commerce for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2029.
dimensions.evidence: $470,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2029

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutory authority under the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5001(c) of the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program authorizations for a defined multi-year period covering fiscal years 2026 through 2029.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2029

missing_information: Total authorized funding levels for the USGS portion of the monitoring system (as only the Department of Commerce allocation is specified in the text)
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the National Volcano Early Warning and Monitoring System and sets specific funding levels through fiscal year 2029.
